original_text: Fully funded PhD positions in Astronomy, Biology, Computer Science, Chemistry & Materials, Data Science & Scientific Computing, Earth Science, Mathematics, Neuroscience, and Physics at Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA). 5-year contracts, competitive salaries, full social security. Applications for 2026 intake OPEN. Deadline: January 8, 2026 (3:00 PM CET).
chinese_translation: 奥地利科学技术研究所（ISTA）全额资助博士职位，覆盖天文学、生物学、计算机科学、化学与材料、数据科学、地球科学、数学、神经科学、物理等。5年合同、国际竞争力薪资、全社保。2026入学申请现已开放，截止2026年1月8日（CET 15:00）。
application_notes: Deadline Jan 8, 2026; fully funded 5-year contracts; Bachelor’s or Master’s acceptable

original_text: Fully funded PhD Studentships in Foundational AI Research as part of the UKRI Science of Fundamental AI Research Lab (SOFAIR). Four-year positions with October 2026 start. Enhanced tax-free stipend (£27,805 for 2026/27), all tuition fees covered at UK Home rates. Expression of interest to Brooks Paige (b.paige@ucl.ac.uk).
chinese_translation: UCL SOFAIR Lab（UKRI基础AI研究实验室）全额资助博士生，研究方向基础AI模型范式。4年资助，2026年10月入学。增强免税津贴（2026/27约£27,805），UK Home学费全覆盖。发送兴趣表达至 Brooks Paige。
application_notes: Rolling for Oct 2026 start; CV + 1-2 page research statement; enhanced stipend

original_text: 15 Fully Funded PhD Positions: StraDiVarious – Strains, Diagnostics and Variants (Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network). Focus on bacterial adhesins, virulence, diagnostics, organoids, proteomics etc. Project starts January 1st, 2026. Apply via https://stradivarious.eu/apply.
chinese_translation: 赫尔辛基大学等联合的StraDiVarious Marie Curie博士网络，15个全额资助博士职位。聚焦细菌粘附素、毒力因子、诊断、类器官、蛋白质组学等。项目2026年1月1日启动。申请见官网。
research_focus: Bacterial pathogenesis, diagnostics, variants, MSCA Doctoral Network
application_notes: 15 positions across consortium; start Jan 2026; apply via project site
